answer_1.quote: In this paper, we first investigate whether the model can truly discern the intent of user query. To explore this issue, we have constructed a new dataset named OKTest (OverKill Test) by introducing certain word-level harmful but semantically benign contents into the sentences.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to user queries, and the study focuses on whether the model refuses to answer safe questions containing harmful words, aiming to reduce such false refusals through Self-Contrastive Decoding.
